content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is a complete commerce infrastructure stack designed for digital creators selling music. It’s built on free, open tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The stack automates product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. You own every component. No platform locks you in. No fees beyond NOWPayments’ 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more than Gumroad would take. This isn’t a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. Built for creators in regions where conventional payment processors are restricted or unreliable.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — free, globally distributed, and CDN-backed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, triggering when a buyer sends crypto. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain via webhook. Once confirmed, the script delivers the product file from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Order data persists in Supabase or Google Sheets. The stack is stateless, serverless, and fully automated. No databases to manage. No servers to maintain. The buyer gets their music instantly. You get paid directly to your wallet. The infrastructure is yours to modify, fork, or relocate.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is for digital creators selling music, beats, presets, or albums in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or impractical. It’s for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. Who want to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC or buyer accounts. Who want to keep 99.5% of every sale. It’s for creators in Nigeria, Pakistan, Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and other regions where financial isolation is a fact of life. This stack turns that isolation into opportunity. You don’t need permission. You need infrastructure. This is it.
Gumroad takes 10%. NOWPayments takes 0.5%. Keep $921 more per 100 sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. NOWPayments processes crypto payments and fires webhooks on confirmation. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores product files. Supabase or Google Sheets logs orders. Each component is free or low-cost. Each is stateless and serverless. Together, they form a stack that’s fully automated, globally distributed, and owner-controlled. No single point of failure. No platform dependency. No recurring fees. Deploy once. Own forever. Sell music on your terms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you’re new to this architecture. It deploys in 48 hours, includes 3 products loaded, and comes with 30-day support. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Workers, Supabase integration, and end-to-end testing. Or download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Every option gives you full ownership. Every option eliminates platform fees. Choose the stack that matches your technical comfort and scale. Deploy today. Sell tomorrow. Own forever.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions, eliminates recurring fees, and gives you full ownership of every component. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack in hours.
No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. No recurring fees. Own every component.

If you’re selling notion templates, fonts, or software, the same infrastructure applies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints for all digital product types. Download it from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Each stack is designed to handle automated delivery, crypto payments, and order storage. Whether you’re in the Philippines or Ethiopia, this architecture works where conventional platforms fail. Own your stack. Keep your earnings.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. Configure file storage in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Log orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify delivery, confirm payment. Deploy live. Load your products. Announce your store. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step guides for each stage.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes templates and blueprints for non-developers. Every option is designed for creators, not engineers.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. Transactions cost under $0.10. No KYC. No buyer accounts required.
Do I need to manage servers?

No. The stack is serverless. GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Cloudflare Workers handle hosting and logic. Google Drive, Cloudflare R2, and Supabase manage storage. You deploy once and own forever.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, the stack retries payment verification. You can also self-host payment verification logic using the blueprints in the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Can I scale this stack to thousands of sales?

Yes. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase scale to enterprise levels. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for high-volume email delivery. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook.
